name: kive
description: Create on-brand product images and videos with Kive from an AI agent.

interface.longDescription: Browse saved products and creative assets, import products, choose visual styles, and create or edit on-brand product images and videos with Kive.
defaultPrompt: Turn this product photo into a saved product and make me three studio-quality shots
Make product shots of my face cream. Show me some studio styles first and let me pick the one I like best
Turn my latest product shot into a short vertical video with a slow reveal

positive.description: List the connected account's Kive workspaces
positive.expected_behavior: List the Kive workspaces available to the connected account without creating or generating anything.

positive.description: Browse saved products without spending credits
positive.prompt: Show me my saved products in Kive and how they look. Do not generate new images.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the saved products and their existing previews, or say clearly when the account has none. Do not generate images or spend credits.

positive.prompt: What video presets does Kive have for product videos?
positive.expected_behavior: Show available Kive video presets for the connected workspace without starting a video generation.

positive.prompt: Show my recent generated images and videos in Kive. Do not create anything new.
positive.expected_behavior: Show existing generations and previews, or say clearly when the connected workspace has none. Do not start generation or spend credits.

positive.prompt: Show me the product-shot studios I can use in Kive.
positive.expected_behavior: Show available Kive studios for the connected workspace without generating an image or spending credits.

negative.prompt: Find the bug in this Python sorting function. It does not use Kive or handle images.
What is the weather in Stockholm this weekend?

negative.description: General image creation with no Kive context
negative.prompt: Draw a watercolor landscape of a mountain lake.
